crossRefs.note: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of…
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed…
But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

translations.web: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
translations.bsb: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
translations.kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
translations.asv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.
